notes: Exact Homage Tradition Amati row from the Sonus faber-authored Homage Tradition owner's manual (the Manualslib-hosted copy identifies this as a passive-loudspeaker manual and its technical table lists Amati, Guarneri, and Serafino). The printed page 29 Technical Specifications row describes a passive 3.5-way floorstander with one H28 XTR-04 tweeter, one M15 XTR-04 midrange, and two 220 mm W22XTR-08 woofers (220 mm converted to 8.66 in for the database's inch field; four total drivers). It publishes 28–35,000 Hz frequency response, 90 dB SPL at 2.83 V/1 m, and 4 ohms nominal impedance. The 100–500 W figure is suggested amplifier output without clipping, not speaker power handling; the separate long-term maximum input voltage is 25 Vrms. The published response range has no stated tolerance; no response points or directivity data are imported. Source: https://www.manualslib.com/manual/1290952/Sonus-Faber-Serafino-Tradition.html?page=29#manual.
